This API is used to create a permanent access key for an IAM user. AKs or SKs are identity credentials for using development tools (API, CLI, and SDK) to access resources and cannot be used for console login. AK is a unique identifier used in conjunction with SK to sign requests cryptographically, ensuring that the requests are secret, complete, and correct.

This API is used to obtain a loginToken for logging in through a custom identity broker. LoginTokens are issued to users to log in through custom identity brokers. Each loginToken contains identity and session information of a user. To log in to a cloud service console using a custom identity broker URL, call this API to obtain a loginToken for authentication. The API can be called using both the global endpoint and region-specific endpoints. For IAM endpoints, see [Regions and Endpoints](https://developer.huaweicloud.com/en-us/endpoint?IAM). > - A loginToken is valid for 10 minutes.

This API is provided for the [administrator](https://support.huaweicloud.com/en-us/usermanual-iam/iam_01_0001.html) to import a metadata file. This API is used to import a metadata file to IAM to implement federated identity authentication. The metadata file specifies API addresses and certificate information in compliance with the SAML 2.0 standard. To obtain the metadata file of your enterprise IdP, contact the enterprise administrator. The API can be called using both the global endpoint and region-specific endpoints. For IAM endpoints, see [Regions and Endpoints](https://developer.huaweicloud.com/en-us/endpoint?IAM).

This API is used to create an MFA device. The API can be called using both the global endpoint and region-specific endpoints. For IAM endpoints, see [Regions and Endpoints](https://developer.huaweicloud.com/en-us/endpoint?IAM).
Creating an OpenID Connect Identity Provider

This API can be used by the [administrator](https://support.huaweicloud.com/en-us/usermanual-iam/iam_01_0001.html) to create a permanent access key for an IAM user or used by an IAM user to create a permanent access key. Access keys are identity credentials for using development tools (APIs, CLI, and SDKs) to access HUAWEI CLOUD. Access keys cannot be used to log in to the console. AK is used in conjunction with an SK to sign requests cryptographically, ensuring that the requests are secret, complete, and correct. For details about how to create an access key on the console, see [Access Keys](https://support.huaweicloud.com/en-us/usermanual-ca/en-us_topic_0046606340.html). The API can be called using both the global endpoint and region-specific endpoints. For IAM endpoints, see [Regions and Endpoints](https://developer.huaweicloud.com/en-us/endpoint?IAM).
This API is used to create a custom identity policy whose default version is **v1**.
This API is used to create a version for a specified identity policy.
This API is used to create a service-linked agency.

This API is used to obtain a temporary access key and securityToken by using an agency. A temporary access key and securityToken are issued by the system to IAM users, and can be valid for 15 minutes to 24 hours. The temporary access key and securityToken follow the principle of least privilege. A temporary access key must be used together with a securityToken, and the x-security-token field must be included in the request header. For more information, see [API Request Signing Guide](https://support.huaweicloud.com/en-us/devg-apisign/api-sign-provide.html). The API can be called using both the global endpoint and region-specific endpoints. For IAM endpoints, see [Regions and Endpoints](https://developer.huaweicloud.com/en-us/endpoint?IAM).

This API is used to obtain a temporary access key and securityToken using a token. A temporary access key and securityToken are issued by the system to IAM users, and can be valid for 15 minutes to 24 hours. The temporary access key and securityToken follow the principle of least privilege. A temporary access key must be used together with a securityToken, and the x-security-token field must be included in the request header. For more information, see [API Request Signing Guide](https://support.huaweicloud.com/en-us/devg-apisign/api-sign-provide.html). The API can be called using both the global endpoint and region-specific endpoints. For IAM endpoints, see [Regions and Endpoints](https://developer.huaweicloud.com/en-us/endpoint?IAM).
Obtaining a Token with an OpenID Connect ID Token

This API is used to obtain an unscoped token through IdP-initiated federated identity authentication. Unscoped tokens cannot be used for authentication. A federated user can be authenticated only using a scoped token. For details, see [Obtaining a Scoped Token](https://support.huaweicloud.com/en-us/api-iam/iam_13_0604.html). The API can be called using both the global endpoint and region-specific endpoints. For IAM endpoints, see [Regions and Endpoints](https://developer.huaweicloud.com/en-us/endpoint?IAM). > - This API can be called using the CLI. The client can call this API to obtain a SAML response in IdP-initiated authentication mode and obtain an unscoped token through a browser.
Obtaining a Token with an OpenID Connect ID Token

This API is used to obtain an agency token. For example, after a trust relationship is established between A and B, A is the delegating party and B is the delegated party. Then B can use this API to obtain an agency token. The obtained agency token can only be used to manage the resources that account B is delegated to manage. If account B needs to manage their own resources, account B needs to obtain a user token. A token is an access credential issued to a user to bear its identity and permissions. When calling the APIs of IAM or other cloud services, you can use this API to obtain a token for authentication. The API can be called using both the global endpoint and region-specific endpoints. Tokens obtained by calling this API using the global endpoint can be used for service access in all regions, whereas tokens obtained by calling this API using a region-specific endpoint can be used only in the same region. For IAM endpoints, see [Regions and Endpoints](https://developer.huaweicloud.com/en-us/endpoint?IAM). > - The validity period of a token is 24 hours. Cache the token to prevent frequent API calling.

Cache the token to prevent frequent API calling. > - For details about how to obtain a token using Postman, see [How Do I Obtain a User Token Using Postman?](https://support.huaweicloud.com/en-us/iam_faq/iam_01_034.html) > - To obtain a token with Security Administrator permissions, see [IAM FAQs](https://support.huaweicloud.com/en-us/iam_faq/iam_01_0608.html).
